extracted.name: Easy Leftover Potato Pancakes
extracted.description: Wondering what to do with leftover mashed potatoes? Make these easy, cheesy potato pancakes; serve with fried eggs for a delicious breakfast or brunch.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed
instruction_lines: Mix potatoes, cheese, beaten egg, and salt in a medium bowl until well combined. If the mixture is very wet, mix in flour as needed to bind mixture together.
Melt butter on a large griddle over medium heat.
Drop potato mixture onto the hot griddle, 1/4 cup at a time.
Flatten each pancake with the back of a spatula to 1/2-inch thickness.
Fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side. Serve hot.
